sources.observed_facts: Default standalone mode; cluster requires redis backend and a nonempty address; Redis settings use duration parsing and documented defaults.
Startup resolves the database dialect before coordination; creates and pings one provider, then wires cluster, cachecoord, auth, session, and plugin services before route/runtime startup.
time.ParseDuration parses timeout strings and rejects invalid or nonpositive values.
Only pgsql links resolve; SQLite, MySQL and unknown prefixes return explicit unsupported errors.
Template documents standalone versus Redis cluster mode and all required Redis connection/timeout fields.
Diagnostics expose coordination backend, health, node ID and primary state.
